# pidginhost_server_packages (Data Source)

Lists the server packages (plans). Use a package's `slug` as the `package` of a `pidginhost_server`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pidginhost_server_packages" "all" {}

# The package with the least memory.
locals {
  by_memory        = { for p in data.pidginhost_server_packages.all.packages : format("%012d|%s", p.memory, p.slug) => p.slug }
  smallest_package = local.by_memory[sort(keys(local.by_memory))[0]]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `generation` (String) Only return packages available on this hardware generation (slug).

### Read-Only

- `packages` (Attributes List) The matching packages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packages))

<a id="nestedatt--packages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `packages`

Read-Only:

- `available_generations` (List of String) Hardware generations this package can be ordered on.
- `cpus` (Number) Number of vCPUs.
- `disk_size` (Number) Boot disk size, as reported by the API.
- `id` (String) Package ID.
- `memory` (Number) Memory, as reported by the API.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Package slug.
- `traffic` (Number) Included monthly traffic, in TB.
